# Mission Stack

> Mission Stack helps U.S. service businesses turn more website inquiries into booked customers by improving their website, lead capture, intake, and follow-up systems. Founder-led, remote, direct communication with every client.

Mission Stack is not a general-purpose AI agency. Automation and AI are tools used to fix specific conversion, intake, and follow-up problems for service businesses — the core offer is the Systems Review and the fixes that follow it.

## Primary offer
- Systems Review: a paid audit covering website, lead capture, intake, and follow-up, delivered as annotated screenshots, a customer-journey map, and a prioritized 30-day action plan.
